title: Return window after the 2026-02-01 policy change
summary: Add the policy change meeting as a source and split the return window by order date: 14 days up to 2026-01-31, 30 days from 2026-02-01. The made-to-order exclusion stays.

judgments.before: A return can be requested within 14 days of delivery.
judgments.proposed: Orders placed from 2026-02-01 can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
judgments.reason: The meeting note states the new window and its start date.

judgments.before: The 14-day rule is stated without a date limit.
judgments.proposed: The 14-day rule applies only to orders placed up to 2026-01-31. The 30-day rule is not applied to all orders.
judgments.reason: The meeting note keeps the existing policy for earlier orders. Applying 30 days to every order would overstate the change.

judgments.before: Made-to-order items are excluded from change-of-mind returns.
judgments.reason: The meeting note says the exclusion stays in place.

judgments.before: One returns source, no later change recorded.
judgments.proposed: Link the two sources both ways. Do not mark them as contested and do not deprecate the older source.
judgments.reason: The two policies cover different order dates, so they are not incompatible claims about the same orders. The older source still governs January orders.
